name: Track irregularity probability model (TIPM)
definition_zh: 基于轨道不平顺谱的统计分布选取代表性谱线，并生成相应不平顺样本的概率模型，用于车辆—轨道系统的随机动力与可靠度分析。
scope_note: TIPM 是特定轨道不平顺概率模型的缩写；与以 K–L 展开等描述随机过程的 TISM 区分。
usage_overview: 将实测不平顺谱的统计分布与累积概率联系起来，选取带有概率信息的代表性谱线并重建样本，用于随机动力响应与可靠度分析。其作用是保留激励的统计差异并减少输入样本规模，与采用 K–L 展开等方式压缩信号的轨道不平顺随机模型应作区分。

complete_examples.text: In this work, methods for simulating track random irregularities are developed by combining the track irregularity probability model (TIPM) and the number theory method and by the Karhunen-Loève expansion (KLE).

On the other hand, the geometric status of track is characterized by PSD from the perspective of the frequency domain, and statistics information of PSD are obtained by massively measured data, i.e., the track irregularity probability model (TIPM) is developed by introducing the point selecting strategy of random samples (Xu et al., 2017; Song et al., 2022).
